[Section] Model Zoo
[source_id=22] In NeuronBlocks, we identify four types of most popular NLP tasks. For each task, we provide various end-to-end network templates.
[source_id=23] [itemsep= -0.4em,topsep = 0.3em, align=left, labelsep=-0.6em, leftmargin=1.2em]
[source_id=24] Text Classification and Matching. Tasks such as domain/intent classification, question answer matching are supported.
[source_id=25] Sequence Labeling. Predict each token in a sequence into predefined types. Common tasks include NER, POS tagging, Slot tagging, etc.
[source_id=26] Knowledge Distillation BIBREF7 . Teacher-Student based knowledge distillation is one common approach for model compression. NeuronBlocks provides knowledge distillation template to improve the inference speed of heavy DNN models like BERT/GPT.
[source_id=27] Extractive Machine Reading Comprehension. Given a pair of question and passage, predict the start and end positions of the answer spans in the passage.
child_qasper_evidence_texts: In NeuronBlocks, we identify four types of most popular NLP tasks. For each task, we provide various end-to-end network templates.
Text Classification and Matching. Tasks such as domain/intent classification, question answer matching are supported.
Sequence Labeling. Predict each token in a sequence into predefined types. Common tasks include NER, POS tagging, Slot tagging, etc.

Knowledge Distillation BIBREF7 . Teacher-Student based knowledge distillation is one common approach for model compression. NeuronBlocks provides knowledge distillation template to improve the inference speed of heavy DNN models like BERT/GPT.
Extractive Machine Reading Comprehension. Given a pair of question and passage, predict the start and end positions of the answer spans in the passage.
